Lead consultant Thairfe Architects and Engineers; MEP consultant Vudree Consulting Engineers. No contractor appointed. Expected completion Jan 2029.

projects.name: Naalu Drainage Scheme
projects.description: Naalu Drainage Scheme is a greenfield sewerage / drainage network project in Umm Al Quwain, valued at AED 1392.0 million, at design. Developed by Mousfer Developments. Lead consultant Qaithem Engineering Consultants. No contractor appointed. Expected completion Apr 2028.

projects.name: Shairees Waste to Energy Plant
projects.description: Shairees Waste to Energy Plant is a greenfield waste to energy plant project in Dubai, valued at AED 79.8 million, at under construction. Developed by Dilsoustor Utilities Authority. Lead consultant Qaiqin Engineering Consultants. No contractor appointed. Expected completion Jul 2029.

projects.name: Zamalel Pumping Station
projects.description: Zamalel Pumping Station is a greenfield pumping station project in Ajman, valued at AED 76.1 million, at completed (above 3 years). Developed by Jetropraa Holdings. Lead consultant Zobokraath Design Consultancy. No contractor appointed. Completed May 2019.

projects.name: Qaathath Solar Park
projects.description: Qaathath Solar Park is a greenfield renewable energy plant project in Abu Dhabi, valued at AED 325.1 million, at tender. Developed by Jinthashal Holdings. Lead consultant Qaivibrin Planning and Design. No contractor appointed. Expected completion Jan 2028.

projects.name: Foukrolvou Dam Phase 2
projects.description: Foukrolvou Dam Phase 2 is a greenfield dam / reservoir project in Sharjah, valued at AED 3896.1 million, at completed (above 3 years). Developed by Thodroson Developments. Lead consultant Zoumshir Design Consultancy. Main contractor Sakeeshas Construction Group. Completed May 2022.

projects.name: Prailrees Treatment Works
projects.description: Prailrees Treatment Works is a greenfield water treatment plant project in Abu Dhabi, valued at AED 34.1 million, at design. Developed by Meekreeth Capital. No consultant recorded. No contractor appointed. Expected completion Jun 2028.

projects.name: Doudraam Drainage Scheme Phase 2
projects.description: Doudraam Drainage Scheme Phase 2 is a greenfield sewerage / drainage network project in Dubai, valued at AED 168.0 million, at under construction. The developer is not yet recorded. Lead consultant Kortrid Engineering Consultants. Main contractor Nidir Construction; MEP contractor Tuthhira Electromechanical Works. Expected completion May 2029.
